summary: Bitcoin tumbled to a low near $65,372 on June 3, shedding over 12% for the week as spot BTC ETFs logged 11 consecutive days of net outflows, with $519 million exiting on June 2 alone — a crypto crash running entirely counter to equity strength. Meanwhile, the US-Iran ceasefire remains fragile, with sporadic hostilities continuing even as bond yields pulled back and stocks rallied on peace hopes, keeping cross-asset sentiment deeply split.
tweet: Bitcoin shed 12% on the week amid mass ETF outflows and liquidations, while traditional markets stayed resilient — the sharpest crypto-equity divergence of 2026.
